product.name: Pawsome UltraComfort 4‑Piece Dog Bed Set
product.description: The Pawsome UltraComfort 4‑Piece Dog Bed Set offers a plush resting solution for medium to large dogs. Each bed features a 120 × 90 × 30 cm footprint, a 4‑inch high memory foam core, and a removable microfiber cover that can be machine washed. The set includes four individual beds, allowing owners to provide separate resting spaces for multiple pets or to create a layered sleeping area. The beds are lightweight yet sturdy, with a weight of 4.5 kg each, and are finished in a deep midnight blue color that complements most home décor. Designed for comfort and durability, the set is suitable for indoor use in living rooms, bedrooms, or pet rooms.
